vocabulary.meaning_en: the service of making and bringing food for an event
a planned occasion, like a party or meeting
a person you invite to your home or party
a happy event for a special day
small pieces of food you can eat with your hand
vocabulary.example: Finger food is good for parties.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small dish you eat before the main meal
small enough to eat in one bite
a long thin stick with pieces of food on it
vocabulary.example: Chicken skewers are a big hit.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea you offer to someone
many different kinds
vocabulary.example: Guests can try a variety of flavors.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sweet food at the end of a meal
a sweet cake made with soft cheese
a small cake baked in a paper cup
two or more things together
a cold drink made from lemon juice, water and sugar
something you like more than other things
how much or how many
the money you plan to spend
a condition where some food makes you ill
vocabulary.example: One guest has a nut allergy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: with no nuts in it

fine_lines.title: dessert vs desert
fine_lines.explanation_ar: dessert (بحرفين s) حلوى بعد الطعام وتُنطق /dɪˈzɜːt/. desert (بحرف s واحد) صحراء وتُنطق /ˈdezət/.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Dessert" (double s) is sweet food. "Desert" (one s) is a hot dry place with sand.

examples.sentence: For dessert, I'd like a cupcake.
The Sahara is a big desert.

fine_lines.title: per person vs in total
fine_lines.explanation_ar: per person = لكل شخص. in total = المجموع الكلي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Per person" = for each person. "In total" = all together.

expressions.phrase: How can I assist you today?
expressions.meaning_en: A formal "How can I help you?"
expressions.example: Good morning. How can I assist you today?

expressions.phrase: We're planning a birthday party for 15 guests.
expressions.meaning_ar: نخطط لحفلة عيد ميلاد لخمسة عشر ضيفًا.
expressions.example: We're planning a dinner for ten guests.

expressions.phrase: What kind of food were you thinking of?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما نوع الطعام الذي كنت تفكر فيه؟
expressions.example: What kind of food were you thinking of for the meeting?
Mini sandwiches are always a big hit.
A party on Sunday? That sounds perfect.
We have the food. What about drinks?
For the drinks, do you have any preferences?
Three pieces per person. Does that sound about right?

expressions.meaning_en: Saying yes to a plan or price.
expressions.example: Sunday at 7? That works for us.

expressions.phrase: Can you make sure none of the dishes contain nuts?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك التأكد من أن الأطباق لا تحتوي على مكسرات؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for special care with food.
expressions.example: Can you make sure the food is not too spicy?

expressions.phrase: We're really looking forward to this party!
expressions.meaning_ar: نحن نتطلع حقًا إلى هذه الحفلة!
expressions.meaning_en: You are excited about a future event.
expressions.example: I'm looking forward to the trip.

grammar.title: I'd recommend / I'd suggest + noun or -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: للنصح بأدب: I'd recommend + اسم، أو I'd suggest + V-ing / اسم. (I'd = I would)
grammar.explanation_en: To give advice politely: "I'd recommend + noun" or "I'd suggest + noun / -ing".
examples: I'd suggest ordering 5 pieces per person.

grammar.title: We'd love to / We'd like to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: للتعبير عن رغبة بأدب: We'd like to have ... / We'd love to have ... (we'd = we would)
grammar.explanation_en: Say what you want politely: "We'd like to ..." / "We'd love to ...".
examples: We'd like to have something sweet.
We'd love to have some finger food.
We'd love to have some options.

grammar.title: look forward to + noun / -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد look forward to نضع اسمًا أو فعلًا بـ ing، وليس الفعل الأساسي.
grammar.explanation_en: After "look forward to", use a noun or an -ing verb, not the base verb.
examples: We're looking forward to this party.
I look forward to seeing you.
She is looking forward to the trip.

questions.question: What is "catering"?
choices: a service that makes and brings food for events
questions.explanation_ar: catering هو خدمة تقديم الطعام للمناسبات.
questions.explanation_en: Catering is a food service for events.

questions.question: "Finger food" is ...
choices: small food you eat with your hand
questions.explanation_en: Small food you eat with your hand.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "For ____, I'd like a cupcake."
"Mini sandwiches are always a big hit." This means ...
questions.explanation_ar: a big hit يعني ناجح ومحبوب جدًا.

questions.question: A guest has a nut allergy. So the food must be ...
questions.explanation_ar: يجب أن يكون الطعام خاليًا من المكسرات.
questions.explanation_en: The food must have no nuts.

questions.question: "That works for us." means ...
choices: That is good for us; we agree.
questions.explanation_ar: That works for us تعني هذا يناسبنا.
questions.explanation_en: It means "That is fine for us."

questions.question: What is a "budget"?
choices: a plan for how much money to spend
questions.explanation_en: A budget is the money you plan to spend.
